original_sentence: Modelled on the movements of a MasterChef contest winner, Tim Anderson, its robotic arms are fixed over a stove and programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
translation: 它的机械臂模仿《厨艺大师》比赛冠军 Tim Anderson 的动作，被固定在炉灶上，并被编程为用生食材制作菜品。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: be fixed over 在本句中对应"被固定在……上方"。
be programmed to 在本句中对应"被编程为"。
modelled on 在本句中对应"以……为模型；模仿"。
raw ingredients 在本句中对应"生食材"。
robotic arms 在本句中对应"机械臂"。

sentence_structure.main_structure: Modelled on the movements of a MasterChef contest winner, Tim Anderson, its robotic arms are fixed over a stove and programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
